comments.text: There’s a group I’m in where YouTube advertisers are shared.  Being on the advertiser list means no one spends money on your business. Nebula and Curiosity Stream are a couple of services I did like, but their advertising presence lead to my non-renewal. Those were a bigger deal, but so many times I’ll be considering a purchase, check the list, and actually buy from another retailer because of their ad presence. Find what you want, check the list, buy from the seller that isn’t on it, and let them know why.
